method: A physics ray from the reference camera tested driving tiles. A separate debug material colored near-road versus ordinary ground, preserved regional shader vertex and distance discards, and made rendered regional terrain black for identification. The displayed Godot viewport was converted to the correct 960 x 720 reference coordinates.

roadSurface.sideLoop: mapped 4.6 m service road, paving unspecified; render defaults to paved, an inference
roadSurface.note: The OSM change date describes the edit, not the date of a physical change. An experimental rule blended optically continuous warm dirt across the unknown access road when independent bare-soil evidence agreed. The left stripe faded but area color error increased; the rule was excluded.

foregroundVegetation.independentSource: USDA NAIP infrared and red bands, 0.6 m, acquisition 2021-08-22, m_3710957_nw_12_060_20210822_20220202
foregroundVegetation.finding: Low 30 m cover near the traveled corridor yields no drivable-view shrub placement at the photograph’s foreground. Nearby tufts in the photo do not establish their current positions or species. No near-camera plants passed the independent strong NIR threshold in the covered barren area. The USGS 1 m bare-earth elevation does not measure shrubs.
